system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated by the fire in his dressing-gown, gazing thoughtfully into the flames","action":"Holmes sits motionless, chin resting on his hand, lost in thought while the firelight plays across his face","setting":"Baker Street sitting room at 221B, gaslit lamps glowing low, coal fire burning in the grate, drawn blinds at the window","secondaryElements":"Dr. Watson in a dark suit standing near the mantel in the background, a few scattered papers and a pipe on a side table, the faint silhouette of the dim street beyond the blinds","mood":"Quiet, reflective, intimate and faintly melancholy with dry restraint","timeOfDay":"Night, 20 March 1888","composition":"Medium interior shot from across the room, Holmes in the lower left third before the fire, Watson softly out of focus at right, warm firelight dominating the frame"}
